core_problem_solved: To provide a convenient and robust API for fetching, parsing, manipulating, and cleaning real-world HTML documents in Java, simplifying tasks like web scraping and server-side DOM manipulation.
key_features: Tolerant parsing of malformed, real-world HTML, similar to modern web browsers
A powerful jQuery-like API with CSS selectors for finding and extracting data
Methods for manipulating HTML elements, attributes, and text
Sanitization features to clean user-submitted HTML and prevent XSS attacks
era_and_niche: The modern, de facto standard library for all HTML processing tasks in the Java ecosystem. It is the go-to choice for web scraping and any server-side HTML manipulation.
reason_for_obsolescence: This library is **not obsolete** and is actively maintained. It is the **modern functional replacement** for a whole generation of older, now-legacy Java HTML parsers like NekoHTML, Jericho HTML Parser, and org.htmlparser.
